data.name: Jewish Beacon Hill
data.headline: Explore the lives of Jewish residents of Beacon Hill's North Slope
data.description:
Journey to Beacon Hill’s North Slope at the turn of the 20th century.

Explore the lives of its Jewish residents during a period of cultural and architectural change.

Uncover how Boston’s Jewish immigrants created an active community that blended customs from Eastern Europe and changes to the new world around them.

Discover sites where Boston’s Jewish West End residents worked, lived and worshiped, including the sites of three synagogues within a few blocks of each other.

##Special Two-Hour Jewish History Tour - Jewish Beacon Hill & The Vilna Shul##
Join us on select Sundays for a unique two-hour Jewish History program that includes Boston By Foot’s guided Jewish Beacon Hill tour and a guided tour of The Vilna Shul.

This special Jewish History tour is open to all and is presented in collaboration with The Vilna Shul.

data.cancellation_notes:
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes early to meet your guide. Late admittance is not guaranteed. 
- Public tours can be rebooked on another available tour, or canceled for full credit as a gift card, with at least 24hrs notice. Customers can conveniently cancel or rebook public tour registrations using the "change booking" and "cancel booking" links in the confirmation and reminder emails. Cancellations less than 24hrs prior to the tour start or no shows cannot be credited.
- Private tours can be canceled up to 4 days before the start for a full refund. Private tour cancellations made within 4 days of the tour date incur a small cancellation fee, though they can be rebooked for no additional fees. Contact us to cancel or rebook a private tour. 
- All tours are held in all weather - rain or shine. Please be prepared for the weather and to walk and stand outdoors on your tour. In case of tour cancellation by Boston By Foot due to extreme weather or unforeseen circumstances, you will be offered a refund or exchange. If groups choose to cancel a tour due to weather, the above policy stands.
data.booking_notes:
For tours that include only the Boston By Foot 90min walking tour, please meet your guide outside of the Vilna Shul.

For 2hr Jewish History tours that include both the Boston By Foot 90min walking tour and a 30min tour of the Vilna Shul, 
- Please meet your guide inside of the Vilna Shul
- The Vilna Shul partners with a parking garage to offer validated discount parking. For more information please visit the Vilna Shul website: [The Vilna Shul Getting Here] (https://www.vilnashul.org/visit/location)
